purpose: Extend source identity beyond the 15-file political diagnostic subset; prior iteration manifests remain historical evidence, not whole-workspace receipts.
also_cover: Workspace and crate Cargo.toml files, Cargo.lock and relevant build.rs/.cargo configuration.
Every other final changed tracked source/input and intentional untracked source, discovered with git diff against baseline and git ls-files --others --exclude-standard.
Final generated leadership production/census/research records and strict art records, after their dependency checks pass.
Final affected JavaScript tests, advisor fixture/provenance, atlas browser harness and workflow configuration.
Full final committed Git object ID and tree ID, with clean status for post-commit/hosted claims; dirty local runs retain their exact working-tree manifest and limitation.
hash_policy: Record original bytes and SHA-256 used by each actual compiled/tested run.
Also record canonical-LF SHA-256 for text whose checkout convention can differ; never replace the historical raw-byte identity with a normalized digest.
All JSON plus government.rs/nations.rs and C01 byte-hashed readers already have LF attributes; verify this before generating new hash-based records.
An old raw hash mismatch resolved only by LF normalization is an encoding equivalence, not an exact raw-byte match.
Never carry an earlier passing outcome across changed source by updating only its hash; rerun affected checks or record explicit source equivalence.
other_final_checks: Execute the four prepared opt-in archive correctness tests against final binaries.
Run leadership production build/check/self-test, campaign census generation/check and relevant Python tests only after source freeze; do not normalize thresholds or approve missing historical claims.
Run read-only original-save/worktree preservation audit after final tests.
Keep optional diagnostics/export generators distinct from unrun correctness assertions; P-6 is now active, so the old90ignored inventory has89ignore attributes before any subsequent changes.
leadership_dependency_review: The production inventory reads authored party tables, historical people and portrait catalogues. The opening-mandate module/data and Army-presence overlay affect runtime institutional behavior, not leadership identities, terms or art eligibility, so they are covered by the whole-runtime source manifest rather than added as purported historical-catalogue dependencies. Government source bytes remain a direct inventory input and require regeneration after any final edit.
out_of_scope: No source mutation, fixture regeneration, native build or test execution is performed by this plan.
